literal: Even if they do unfriendly things intending division, not doing harmful things intending hostility is the best.
translation: Even if others perform disagreeable acts to cause division, it is best to refrain from doing harmful deeds out of hostility.
modern: பிரிவை விரும்பிப் பிறர் நமக்கு வெறுக்கத்தக்கவற்றைச் செய்தாலும், நாம் மாறுபாட்டைக் கருதி அவர்களுக்குத் துன்பம் செய்யாமல் இருப்பதே மிகச் சிறந்தது.
explanation: This couplet advises on how to respond to provocation and attempts at division. Even when others commit unfriendly acts with the explicit intention of causing a split or discord, one must not retaliate. Refraining from doing harmful deeds out of a spirit of hostility is described as the foremost or best path. By choosing not to return harm for harm, one rises above enmity and prevents further conflict.
